messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
These are the federal holidays that either fell on a Friday or a Monday (or were observed on a Monday when they landed on a weekend).  (Some provinces have extra holidays that create their own long weekends – see the “Provincial notes” column for a few examples.)

| # | Holiday | Calendar Date (2023) | Observed (if different) | Long‑Weekend Span | Provincial notes |
|---|---------|----------------------|--------------------------|-------------------|------------------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 | **Dec 31 – Jan 2** (Sat‑Mon) | — |
| 2 | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Monday Feb 20 | — | **Feb 18 – Feb 20** (Fri‑Mon) | Ontario has *St. Patricks’ Day* (Mar 17) |
| 3 | Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | — | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** (Fri‑Sun) | — |
| 4 | Victoria Day | Monday May 24 | — | **May 22 – May 24** (Fri‑Mon) | — |
| 5 | Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 | **Jul 1 – Jul 3** (Sat‑Mon) | — |
| 6 | Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | — | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** (Fri‑Mon) | — |
| 7 | Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | — | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** (Fri‑Mon) | — |
| 8 | Remembrance Day | Saturday Nov 11 | Monday Nov 13 | **Nov 11 – Nov 13** (Sat‑Mon) | Observed only in some provinces |
| 9 | Christmas Day | Monday Dec 25 | — | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** (Fri‑Mon) | — |
|10 | Boxing Day | Tuesday Dec 26 | — | **Dec 25 – Dec 27** (Mon‑Wed) | Combined with Christmas gives a 5‑day break |

### How to read the table
- **Calendar Date** is the actual day the holiday falls on in 2023.  
- **Observed** shows the day the holiday is officially taken if the calendar date lands on a weekend.  
- **Long‑Weekend Span** lists the consecutive days off that result from the holiday (including the weekend before or after).  
- **Provincial notes** point out any extra holidays that might create additional long weekends in specific provinces.

### Quick summary of the longest breaks
| Break | Length | Dates |
|-------|--------|-------|
| New Year’s long weekend | 3 days | Dec 31 – Jan 2 |
| Family Day long weekend | 3 days | Feb 18 – Feb 20 |
| Good Friday long weekend | 3 days | Apr 7 – Apr 9 |
| Victoria Day long weekend | 3 days | May 22 – May 24 |
| Canada Day long weekend | 3 days | Jul 1 – Jul 3 |
| Labour Day long weekend | 3 days | Sep 2 – Sep 4 |
| Thanksgiving long weekend | 3 days | Oct 7 – Oct 9 |
| Remembrance Day long weekend | 3 days | Nov 11 – Nov 13 |
| Christmas long weekend | 4 days | Dec 23 – Dec 26 |
| Christmas + Boxing Day | 5 days | Dec 23 – Dec 27 |

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need province‑specific long weekends (e.g., Family Day in Ontario, St. Patricks’ Day in Ontario, etc.), let me know and I can add those too!
